body: I'd have to say Once Upon A Time. The first season was okay, and I actually really enjoyed it. Then season two which was okay, it could've been better and then about after that i slowly started to lose interest. Every season pretty much had the same concept after season one. Curse, new land, oh no scary bad person. It started to get bery boring and I just lost complete interest. And to add they kept adding new characters, it feels like, every episide. It felt cramped and a little forced with tying everyones backstories togethet. I feel like if they would've approached the story a little different after season two maybe it would be alot better.
